article.story: UMKC Roos (2-2) vs. George Mason Patriots (2-0) St. Petersburg, Florida; Thursday, 3 p.m. EST LINE: Patriots -14.5; over/under is 140.5 BOTTOM LINE: George Mason plays UMKC in St. Petersburg, Florida. George Mason finished 23-10 overall with a 12-2 record against non-conference opponents in the 2025-26 season. The Patriots averaged 73.3 points per game last season, 16.5 on free throws and 18.9 from 3-point range. UMKC finished 4-27 overall with a 3-13 record in non-conference games during the 2025-26 season.
